updates.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want to activate a store-stock phone while the customer keeps their number from another carrier, so that the port is accepted, the old carrier is shown and nothing extra is charged up to the payment screen
updates.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
When a customer comes into a Metro by T-Mobile store to start service, they can take a brand-new Metro phone number or keep the number they already have with another carrier. Keeping the number is called porting it in. On the Phone number selection screen the rep picks Port phone number and types the customer's current number, the account number and the PIN the customer has with the old carrier, each twice to catch typing mistakes. RT Go then asks the carrier whether that number can be moved. If it can, the order carries on exactly like a new-number order: protection, plan, promotions, add-ons, create subscriber, order summary, accessories and payment. The port itself costs nothing. Getting this wrong loses the customer their number or activates them on a number the carrier refuses, so the port details must be checked, shown back to the rep and carried through to the payment screen unchanged. This test walks the whole thing with a phone from store stock and a number the carrier reports as Verizon: the port is accepted, the carrier details are shown in the cart drawer, the port-specific rebate is offered, and the order reaches the payment screen with the same amount as a new-number order. It stops before any money is taken.

Words used in this test: a line activation is the sale that puts a phone on the Metro network for a customer. The rep is the store employee at the counter. Porting (or a port-in) means moving a phone number the customer already has with another carrier over to Metro, so the customer keeps the number. The old carrier is the company the customer is leaving; to allow the move, that carrier needs the customer's account number and the account PIN with them. An IMEI is the 15-digit serial number of a phone. A SIM number (also called ICCID) is the long number printed on the SIM card. A plan code such as MAU55 is the carrier's short name for a monthly plan. A rebate is money taken off the phone's price when a promotion applies. Store stock means a phone the store sells from its own inventory, as opposed to a phone the customer already owns.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2018 (Port-In Activations epic), RTPL-2063 (port-in screens), RTPL-2022 (port check), RTPL-3023 (current carrier shown), RTPL-2409 (port rebate on the Promotion screen)

## Preconditions
- The rep can sign in to RT Go on the QA site (go-mbyt-qa.rt2.com) with the team's QA sign-in. On a fresh sign-in a User settings drawer opens by itself; in it the Environment box must be set to UAT2 (the November UAT2 data workbook is where the phones and SIMs below come from).
- No other sale or activation is open on this till. If one is, cancel it before beginning.
- The till has no customer tablet paired to it, so the PIN and the three security questions are typed on the till screen.
- The phone and SIM below have not been used by a finished sale.

## Test data
- **Store:** EZLOGIC, dealer code 30247306; station SCOTT-TEST (the station is the one you sign in on)  _(verified: UAT2 2026-11-03 (build 5.954.0), walked click by click on go-mbyt-qa.rt2.com; shown in the page header after sign-in)_
- **New customer:** First name PORT, middle initial T, last name TESTER; email: type a brand-new address each run, for example port.<today's date and time>@rt2.com; address 405 LEXINGTON AVE, zip 10174 (city NEW YORK, state fills in as NY); PIN 628193; any three different security questions with any answers; ID check phone 2125551234  _(verified: UAT2 2026-11-03 (build 5.954.0), walked click by click on go-mbyt-qa.rt2.com; the account was created and the ID check passed with these values three times)_
- **Phone from store stock:** IMEI 999939175460833 (SKU 610214688811), physical SIM. Device line $255.29 = $229.99 price + $23.00 sales tax + $2.30 PP Tax  _(verified: UAT2 Nov workbook, Astock sheet; UAT2 2026-11-03 (build 5.954.0), walked click by click on go-mbyt-qa.rt2.com: the neighbouring rows 999939177538073 and 999939173297229 were accepted and activated (orders 630036286, 630036287) and this row is the next unused one. If it is refused, take 999939173294978, then the next row up the sheet)_
- **SIM card:** ICCID 8901260000084313027F  _(verified: UAT2 Nov workbook, Astock sheet; UAT2 2026-11-03 (build 5.954.0), walked click by click on go-mbyt-qa.rt2.com: the neighbouring SIMs 8901260000084313009F and 8901260000084313018F were accepted; this is the next unused one. If refused, take 8901260000084313036F)_
- **Number to port:** 2483031112 - the carrier reports it as VERIZON WIRELESS-CA, submarket Detroit  _(verified: UAT2 2026-11-03 (build 5.954.0), walked click by click on go-mbyt-qa.rt2.com: accepted at the port check, activated with Create subscriber and walked to the payment screen. Alternates that passed the port check but were not walked further: 2483036904 and 5038750770 (both Verizon). Never use 2146641469 (Create subscriber is refused with Activation failed) and do not use 5038751234 for a port-rebate check (it is a T-Mobile number, so no port rebate is offered))_
- **Old-carrier account number and PIN:** Account number 123456789, PIN 1234  _(verified: UAT2 2026-11-03 (build 5.954.0), walked click by click on go-mbyt-qa.rt2.com: accepted; the test carrier takes any digits here (confirmed by the product owner on QA-2682, 2026-08-21))_
- **Plan:** MAU55, $60.00 per month (already marked Selected on the Plan selection screen)  _(verified: UAT2 2026-11-03 (build 5.954.0), walked click by click on go-mbyt-qa.rt2.com; cart read Plan (MAU55) $60.00 / mo.)_
- **Promotions offered for this ported number:** $55 Device Rebate (COUP_NEUVQ4) and $55 Port Device Rebate (COUP_NEUVQ5), both against the $229.99 phone  _(verified: UAT2 2026-11-03 (build 5.954.0), walked click by click on go-mbyt-qa.rt2.com; the Promotion selection screen read Great news, customer is eligible for 2 promotions.)_
- **Expected amounts:** Cart Total due $255.29 before and after the port; after the plan: Estimated monthly $60.00, Total due $315.29. Order summary: Total MRC $60.00, Total taxes & fees $0.00, Total PP Tax $2.30, Edge due immediately $60.00. Payment screen: Collect $315.29  _(verified: UAT2 2026-11-03 (build 5.954.0), walked click by click on go-mbyt-qa.rt2.com; read off the Cart, the Order summary and the Collect payment from customer screen)_

## Automation Notes
- If the phone or SIM is refused, or the amounts differ from this ticket, take the next phone and SIM from the Astock sheet of the UAT2 November data workbook (999939173294978 / 8901260000084313036F, then the next row up) and re-read the Cart. If the pool is exhausted or the data behaves differently than described, contact the manual QA team to help get working data - do not sit blocked and do not hunt for data alone.
- If 2483031112 is ever refused at the port check, try 2483036904 and then 5038750770 (both reported as Verizon on 2026-11-03, accepted at the port check but not walked to Create subscriber). Never use 2146641469: it passes the port check and then Create subscriber fails with Activation failed - This activation could not be completed. Contact the support team. Number is not eligible for Port In.
- Never click Collect amount or Submit order. The test ends before any payment is taken.
- The Phone number npa nxx window opens by itself on the Phone number selection screen and blocks every click until it is closed - close it first.
- CONFIRM BEFORE AUTOMATING: the note Currently RTGO supports new phone number activations. Please continue to use RTPOS for port activations. is old text that is still shown even though porting now works (raised with the product owner). Do not fail the test on that sentence if it disappears.
- CONFIRM BEFORE AUTOMATING: PP Tax ($2.30 on the $229.99 phone) is what the UAT2 store charged on 2026-11-03 (1% of the price). If the store's rate or the phone price changes, re-read the Cart at the SIM validation step and update the figures.

steps.expected: A User settings drawer opens by itself with an Environment box. Pick UAT2 in it and close the drawer. The dashboard shows and the header reads STORE ID EZLOGIC and DEALER CODE 30247306. Open the user menu (top right) and check the Environment box reads UAT2.

steps.action: On the dashboard, click the New account tile
steps.expected: The screen opens with a form headed Account information with First name, Middle initial, Last name, Email, Address, Address 2, Zip code, City, State, PIN, Confirm PIN and three Security question and Answer pairs. The Cart on the right shows Account with no lines.

steps.action: Fill in the customer's first name, middle initial, last name, email, address and zip code
steps.expected: The City box fills in by itself with NEW YORK and the State box with NY after the zip code is typed.

steps.action: Type the PIN twice, choose three different security questions and type an answer for each
steps.expected: The Continue button becomes available.
The message Adding account... shows briefly, then the heading changes to ID verification with the customer's name and email already filled in and a Phone box.

steps.action: Type the phone number into the Phone box and click Continue
steps.expected: The screen reads Congratulations, your customer's ID has been verified. followed by Your customer qualifies for the best promotional pricing whenever available. and an ID Verification Reference # with a Continue button.
The heading changes to IMEI validation and reads Enter the IMEI of the device to verify network compatibility and inventory.

steps.action: Type the phone's IMEI into the IMEI box
steps.expected: The message Processing request... shows briefly. The heading then changes to SIM validation and reads The device is physical SIM compatible. Confirm your IMEI and SIM card pair below, then click continue. with IMEI 1 - PSIM selected. The Cart lists the IMEI with Device $255.29, PP Tax $2.30 and Total due $255.29.

steps.action: Type the SIM's ICCID into the ICCID SIM box and click Continue
steps.expected: The heading changes to Phone number selection. The Cart now also lists SIM card $0.00 and still reads Total due $255.29. A window headed Phone number npa nxx opens by itself listing numbers such as (347) 499-* NWYRCYZN05, NY.

steps.action: Close the Phone number npa nxx window (click its X or press Escape)
steps.expected: The Phone number selection screen is fully visible. Under the heading a note reads Currently RTGO supports new phone number activations. Please continue to use RTPOS for port activations. Below it, Select phone number type * offers two cards: New phone number - Get a new Metro phone number (already selected) and Port phone number - Switch carrier and keep existing phone number. Under the cards are Enter service area zip code * and Phone number NPA NXX * with a Select button. Continue is greyed out.

steps.action: Click the Port phone number card
steps.expected: The card shows a tick. The zip code and NPA NXX boxes disappear and six boxes appear in two columns: Phone number to port *, Confirm phone number to port *, Current account number *, Confirm current account number *, Current PIN *, Confirm current PIN *. Continue is greyed out.

steps.action: Type the number to port in both Phone number to port and Confirm phone number to port, the old-carrier account number in both account number boxes and the old-carrier PIN in both PIN boxes
steps.expected: The phone boxes show the number as (248) 303-1112. The account number shows exactly as typed. The PIN boxes show dots. Continue becomes available (purple).

A window reading Adding phone number port... covers the screen for a few seconds and no second click is possible. It closes and the heading changes to Protection selection, listing Metro Complete Protection $10.00 per month, Metro Advanced Protection $6.00 per month and Metro Basic Protection $3.00 per month with Skip and Continue buttons. The Cart now shows a new row Phone number port (248) 303-1112 under the SIM card row, and Total due still reads $255.29 - the port adds no charge. SERVICE CHECK (for the automation engineer): the configure-mdn response's mdnConfigDetails reads type "port-in", mdn "2483031112", currentCarrier "VERIZON WIRELESS-CA", submarketName "Detroit", providerId "6006", submarketCode "070", stateCode "MI", accountNumber "123456789".

steps.action: In the Cart, click the Phone number port row
steps.expected: A drawer slides in from the right headed Phone number port with these rows: Phone number type port-in, Port-in MDN (248) 303-1112, Current carrier VERIZON WIRELESS-CA, Carrier account number 123456789, Submarket Detroit, and a Back button. The PIN is not shown anywhere in the drawer.
The drawer closes and the Protection selection screen is unchanged.
A window headed Decline all protection options? asks Are you sure you want to decline protection? with the buttons Yes, continue and Back.

The heading changes to Plan selection with MAU55 ($60.00 per month) already marked Selected. The Cart shows Protection Declined, Plan (MAU55) $60.00 / mo., Phone number port (248) 303-1112, Estimated monthly $60.00 and Total due $315.29. SERVICE CHECK (for the automation engineer): the configure-plan response reads planConfigDetails.selectedPlanSocCode "MAU55" and selectedPlanRate 60.

The heading changes to Promotion selection and reads Great news, customer is eligible for 2 promotions. Select then continue below. Two cards show, each with the phone's price $229.99: $55 Device Rebate (COUP_NEUVQ4) - Customers who activate a new line of service on select plans are eligible for discounts off select phones. - and $55 Port Device Rebate (COUP_NEUVQ5) - Customers who port a new line of service on select plans are eligible for discounts off select phones. Limit 2 Instant Rebates per account during promo period. Each card has a Select button; below are Decline and Continue buttons.

A window headed Decline all promotions and continue? reads Decline available promotions? This customer is eligible for promotional offers. The device will be sold at full price if none are applied. with the buttons Continue and Back.

The heading changes to Add on services. The Cart still shows Phone number port (248) 303-1112, Device $255.29 and Total due $315.29. SERVICE CHECK (for the automation engineer): the configure-promotions response reads promotionsSkipped true and selectedPromotions empty.
A window headed Create subscriber reads Great job configuring IMEI 999939175460833. Click create subscriber to continue. with the buttons Create subscriber and Back.

After a short wait a window headed Subscriber created asks Would you like to add another line to the order, or view Charge Summary and checkout? with the buttons Add another line and Continue to order summary.

The heading changes to Order summary. Under Due Immediately it lists an Order ID, an Account number, Lines in order 1, Total MRC $60.00, Total taxes & fees $0.00, Total PP Tax $2.30 and Edge due immediately $60.00, then the SOS form language choices English and Español, a Metro bill payment box and Back and Continue buttons. The Cart still shows the Phone number port (248) 303-1112 row, Add-on Declined and Total due $315.29.
The heading changes to Add accessories with Scan accessory item and Browse accessories. The Cart reads Inventory $0.00, PP Tax $2.30 and Total due $315.29.

steps.action: Click Continue without adding an accessory
steps.expected: A drawer slides in from the right headed Financing reading Congratulations, financing is available! Buy now, pay later. No hidden fees. with Affirm and SmartPay and the buttons No thanks and Continue.
A window headed Decline Financing asks Are you sure you want to continue this payment without a financing loan? with the buttons Decline and Go back.

The heading changes to Collect payment from customer and reads Collect $315.29 with cash, card, or split the payment across multiple methods. The Pay with choices are Cash, Debit card and Credit card with an Amount box and a Collect amount button. The Cart lists the phone line $315.29, Customer payments $0.00, Cash $0.00, PP Tax $2.30, Total due $315.29, Total collected $0.00, Balance due $315.29 and Change due back to customer $0.00. Below the Cart is the line Receipt: English, small, Quantity 1 - Edit Settings and a greyed-out Submit order button.

steps.action: Stop here - do NOT click Collect amount and do NOT click Submit order
steps.expected: Nothing further is checked. The phone, SIM and ported number stay reusable for the next run.
